text:
lina: quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem — dropping the remediation list here. can owners ack and confirm target dates? postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/gpu-capacity-2026

lina: action items (short):
1) request quota bump for us-west GPUs (cloud quota) -> owner: devin, need finance ok
2) headroom policy + default headroom config -> owner: devin
3) scheduler tuning (packing + preemption rules) -> owner: kai
4) autoscaler thresholds & cooldown tuning -> owner: alex
5) runbook + alert playbook updates -> owner: alex
6) recurring checkpoint + incident-pattern review -> owner: lina

devin: ack. I'll take 1 & 2. proposing +8 p4d-equivalent in us-west, default headroom = 20%. target for quota request: 2026-04-10. will post cost calc in #eng-finance.

kai: ack for 3. plan: test bin-packing + stricter preemption priorities on a canary pool for 2 weeks, collect queuing metrics. target config PR: 2026-04-17. note: saw same long-tail queuing pattern in last 3 incidents.

alex: ack for 4 & 5. for autoscaler: bump target utilization from 60% -> 70%, shorten scale-down cooldown to 120s, increase max-burst cap for sudden spikes. i'll open PR for alerts + runbook updates by 2026-04-05.

maria: finance here — need the delta and expected monthly ops cost before approving quota bump. devin, can you paste the rough numbers here? also cc'ing billing-team.

devin: numbers pasted:
```
estimate: +8 p4d equiv (~p4d price proxy)
expected additional infra cost: $2.7k / month
expected one-time provisioning slack: none
```
I'll add more detail in #eng-finance with the SKU breakdown.

lina: noted. can alex make the runbook PR reference the postmortem and include rollback steps? also adding a follow-up item: add an incident tag for "gpu-queue-spike" so we can filter recurring ones.

alex: yep, runbook PR will include: summary, alert thresholds, run commands, rollback to smaller instance types, and a link to the postmortem. tagging in the PR.

kai: on the pattern side — long-seq model jobs are the main contributor to headroom erosion. suggest enforcing a QoS class and per-job seq-length cap for non-prod tenants as a short-term mitigation. logging that in the tracker.

lina: can we make a 2-week recurring checkpoint until the metrics show stability? prefer async updates in this thread, but schedule a 30m sync if any owner needs a decision. ops-bot, please set a reminder. :calendar:

ops-bot: Reminder created: "GPU capacity follow-up checkpoint" on 2026-04-12 17:00 UTC, recurring every 2 weeks.

alex: ack, will post runbook PR link here when ready.

devin: opened quota ticket with cloud, keeping everyone posted. ETA for approval depends on billing sign-off.

lina: thanks everyone. i'll consolidate owners & dates into the postmortem follow-up doc after the morning. if anyone needs to change ownership, ping me in-thread.
